locations.section: item 14a retention rule, custody, state and precedence
E3-T9 boundary and production order controls

findingResolution.assessment: The body-id union cap is now the actual retained carrier maximum of 100,000. After withholding oversized components, the remaining groups are sorted by raw canonical group digest and retained as one longest prefix within both caps. No component is cut, no retained member loses its custody row, and any withholding forces partial with budget-exhausted/null unless a higher-precedence pair applies. Models of 100,000 and 100,001 individually valid distinct ids retain 100,000 and 98,304 rows respectively, with complete and partial states. Production order does not alter the retained prefix. Existing examined-path, opaque id, whole-file snapshot custody, producer/stage and deficiency joins remain intact. E-R3-NB-01 is control wording, not a defect in the rule.

locations.section: item 4 normalization roots, paths, bounds and retention

findingResolution.assessment: The IE map is now an explicit second closed-tree root, canonical under its registered schema. A6 joins normalizerId to the manifest, requires exactly the four ascending levels, and resolves each digest to the fixed level path with tree size/digest and actual retained-byte joins. Native normalizer.v1.json remains a separate manifest member. Unlisted members still refuse, on either execution branch. The original IE Run-closure checks remain unchanged and the admission-side checks complement them. The positive and missing/mismatched/extra closure controls cover both branches.

locations.section: E2s exact selectors, output registry and new controls

findingResolution.assessment: SYN-1(f) explicitly keeps startup reasons unchanged and correctly identifies Coverage references to the native owner. The five foundation enum selectors exactly match the live census. The product census matches all 13 listed selectors: five schema enum copies, the native allowed-causes row and seven evaluator-registry copies/allowed-causes rows. No additional matching copy was found in the scanned product schema sources or evaluator registries. The eight output paths exactly match schemas/registry.json. Startup TypeScript post-Analyze reasons and native UnavailableReasonV3 remain separate unchanged vocabularies. E2s-T1/T2 bind the mirror addition and the lawful Coverage/candidate carrier without widening Unavailable.reason.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The 100,001-id example says to add one member to any group, but 24 of its groups already contain 4,096 members. Adding to one of those first triggers the per-group withholding rule, rather than isolating the new union cap. The intended positive/negative exists by growing the 1,696-member group to 1,697. Also, the 1,000,000-group cap is dominated by the 100,000-body cap for disjoint components; a production case cannot independently reach the former first.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: Specify that the extra member goes into the 1,696-member group so all groups remain individually valid. Document the dominated group-count bound, and if a generic prefix routine receives separate branch coverage under reduced model/fixture caps, label that evidence accordingly. Keep the production carrier bounds unchanged.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: A3/A6 and E2-T34 add -normalization-map-mismatch, but SYN-1(d) does not include it in its explicit enumeration of newly added keys. Item 5 line 239 and SYN-1(d) universally bind every native.syntax-grammar-* / native.syntax-normalizer-* key to the pre-Plan route, so the route remains defined.
nonBlockingObservations.recommendation: Add the new map key to SYN-1(d)'s explicit list so the successor checklist agrees with A3/A6.
